of_age.title: Of Age
of_age.text: {name} turns sixteen today and takes a place in the crew. The whole shelter knows it. How do you mark it?

options.label: Out on patrol with the fighters

new_child.title: A Child Is Born
new_child.text: {name} is born to the family. In a city like this one, every birth is a small act of defiance.

mourning.title: Mourning
mourning.text: {name} is dead. The crew looks to you for how to grieve.

glory.title: Glory
glory.text: {name} came back from the {venture} with a triumph, and the whole crew is talking about it.

hard_loss.title: A Hard Loss
hard_loss.text: The {venture} led by {name} ended in disaster. People are asking whose fault it was.

rats.title: Rats in the Stores
rats.text: Rats have got into the food stores. Some of it can still be saved, if you're not too fussy.

stranger_with_maps.title: A Stranger with Maps
stranger_with_maps.text: A drifter offers hand-drawn maps of the ruins beyond your border, and asks for shelter in return.

market_rumours.title: Market Rumours
market_rumours.text: Rumours are running through the markets: someone is hoarding, someone is cheating. Traders are nervous.

council_quarrel.title: A Quarrel on the Council
council_quarrel.text: Your councillors are at each other's throats: the fighters want more, the builders want peace.

fever.title: Fever in the Shelters
fever.text: A fever is spreading through the crowded shelters.

cache_of_tools.title: A Cache of Tools
cache_of_tools.text: Your crew has found a sealed cache of tools: saws, jacks, a working generator.

hot_blooded_youths.title: Hot-Blooded Youths
hot_blooded_youths.text: The young ones are restless and want a fight. They'll find one, with or without you.

upbringing.title: Who Raises the Child
upbringing.text: {name} is six, old enough to learn. Who brings them up, and toward what? It will shape the adult they become at sixteen.
upbringing.change_text: A new direction for {name}? What they've learned so far stays with them; from now on the new upbringing shapes them. Once changed, it stays for at least a year.

schoolyard_bully.title: The Schoolyard
schoolyard_bully.text: An older child has been bullying the little ones at school. {name} stood up to them, fists first.

options.label: Teach them to talk it down

shelter_friends.title: Friends from the Shelters
shelter_friends.text: {name} spends every spare hour with children from the poorest shelters, and has started to talk like them.

hid_in_raid.title: Hiding in the Cellar
hid_in_raid.text: When the alarm went up last night, {name} hid in the cellar and wouldn't come out until morning.

options.label: Next time, stand with the guards

harsh_lessons.title: Harsh Lessons
harsh_lessons.text: {name}'s tutor drives the lessons in hard: long hours, a sharp tongue, and worse when they slip.

the_ledger.title: Keeping the Books
the_ledger.text: {name} has been helping count the stores, and caught someone skimming.

options.label: Let them give it to the hungry

at_the_table.title: At the Leader's Table
at_the_table.text: {name} has started sitting in when the council meets, listening to every word.

options.label: Send them back to their chores

stray_dog.title: A Stray
stray_dog.text: {name} brought home a half-starved dog and wants to keep it, though food is short.

a_match.title: A Match
a_match.text: {name} is of an age to marry. A match binds people to the family, and shapes the children to come.

options.label: Not yet
options.note: Nothing changes. They'll be asked again in two years.
